questions.prompt: What do Anna and her friends enjoy doing outside during lunch?
questions.evidence: But the weather is beautiful and people-watching is fun!
questions.explanation: people-watching 指观察来往的人。这里明确说天气好、观察行人很有趣；没有说午休时玩桌游或买衣服，不能只凭常见午休活动来选。

spokenEvidence.quote: But the weather is beautiful and people-watching is fun!

questions.prompt: How does Anna describe her own eyes? Write ONE WORD for the colour.
questions.explanation: Anna 的 I 指她自己，她说自己的眼睛是 blue。前面的 brown eyes 说的是 Keyana 和 Ashley；要分清同一句里不同人的指代。题目要一个颜色词，不加 eyes。

questions.prompt: Which two women have curly hair?
questions.evidence: Keyana and I have curly hair.
questions.explanation: 这句是 Anna 说的，所以 I 指 Anna，Keyana and I 就是 Keyana 和 Anna。Ashley 的头发是 straight；Caty 后来也被描述为 straight, light hair。

spokenEvidence.quote: Keyana and I have curly hair.

questions.prompt: Why does Anna stay outside after Ashley says she has to go?
questions.evidence: I still have time. And this sun feels so good!
questions.explanation: Anna 给出的理由是自己还有时间，而且阳光很舒服。对话没有说老板取消工作或她在等公交车，不能把猜测当成原文信息。
answers: She says she still has time.
options: She says she still has time.
She is waiting for a bus.

spokenEvidence.quote: I still have time. And this sun feels so good!

questions.prompt: What object does Anna say she is looking for behind the bench? Write ONE WORD.
questions.explanation: 被老板发现后，Anna 说自己在找 stick，并接着说 Here it is。题目问她说出的物品，不是她躲的位置 bench，也不是她实际在做的 people-watching。

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Weaver suggest after finding Anna?
questions.evidence: No need to hurry. I love people-watching too! Let’s sit!
questions.explanation: No need to hurry 表示不必急着走，Let’s sit 是邀请一起坐下；她也喜欢观察行人。Anna 原先担心被催回去，但老板实际说的话与这个担心不同。
answers: Sitting down together to watch people.
options: Sitting down together to watch people.

spokenEvidence.quote: No need to hurry. I love people-watching too! Let’s sit!
